verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents SOC 2 as a supported framework that automatically adds its controls. It also ships Formal and Comprehensive policy templates you can adapt and publish, and offers AI-agent evidence collection through Fieldwork. Nothing in the evidence explicitly covers Type I versus Type II, so end-to-end program support is only implied. missing for 10: explicit Type I and Type II audit support, named Trust Services Criteria control mapping, documented evidence-request workflows tied to SOC 2 controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run a SOC 2 program end to end — Type I and Type II — with the Trust Services controls, required policies, and evidence requests built into the platform

citations.quote: Whether you need SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR, or another framework. Oneleet's all-in-one platform simplifies your compliance journey.
Leverage Oneleet as your security team with a dedicated vCISO to create your SOC 2 program & help you pass security reviews.
Removing a framework also removes unused controls that were automatically added for it.
Our platform offers two types of policy templates to assist you in this process: Formal (Minimum Viable Policies)... Comprehensive
Fieldwork’s AI agents collect, validate, and package the evidence – across your enterprise systems, on your schedule.
